problem_text:
A logistics company is tasked with delivering seven distinct categories of goods to a distribution hub, each requiring passage through seven sequential handling stages. The revenue generated per ton for each good category is outlined below:
* For Good Alpha, revenue is 9.439 per ton
* For Good Beta, revenue is 17.131 per ton
* For Good Gamma, revenue is 18.696 per ton
* For Good Delta, revenue is 10.235 per ton
* For Good Epsilon, revenue is 14.568 per ton
* For Good Zeta, revenue is 10.711 per ton
* For Good Eta, revenue is 13.681 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each stage is as follows:
* For Good Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.452 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.103 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.414 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.563 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.718 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.54 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.589 (ton-hours)
* For Good Beta, Stage 1 consumes 1.126 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.117 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.654 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.131 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.82 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.6 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.111 (ton-hours)
* For Good Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 1.687 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.057 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.815 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.98 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.021 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.371 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.294 (ton-hours)
* For Good Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.513 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.943 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.026 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.324 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.562 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.386 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.661 (ton-hours)
* For Good Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 1.629 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.202 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.772 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.891 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.533 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.512 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.938 (ton-hours)
* For Good Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 0.849 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.661 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.216 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.983 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.23 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.294 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.871 (ton-hours)
* For Good Eta, Stage 1 consumes 1.696 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.759 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.68 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.907 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.1 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.854 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.838 (ton-hours)

The cumulative handling duration allocated for each stage is strictly limited:
* Stage 1's total handling duration must not exceed 284.26 hours
* Stage 2's total handling duration must not exceed 149.792 hours
* Stage 3's total handling duration must not exceed 190.826 hours
* Stage 4's total handling duration must not exceed 207.798 hours
* Stage 5's total handling duration must not exceed 217.598 hours
* Stage 6's total handling duration must not exceed 187.338 hours
* Stage 7's total handling duration must not exceed 171.094 hours

Given the imperative to ensure that the total processing time for each individual stage—Stage 1 through Stage 7—does not surpass its respective available capacity, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each good category to maximize the aggregate revenue.
